tree.heading: Proclamation.—
tree.text: The President is requested to issue each year a proclamation calling on—

children.text: the people of the United States to observe National Maritime Day by displaying the flag of the United States at their homes or other suitable places; and
United States Government officials to display the flag on all Government buildings on National Maritime Day.
